node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotional conditions in Scope. Failure returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than the typed negative or compliant result. This conflicts with an unrestricted assessment domain; an intended narrower domain remains an unresolved alternative.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-wide promotional connection with the existence of a non-discount gift without expressly requiring that the same component have that connection. Mixed offers could be overclassified unless the supplied classifications establish the component's promotional link.
The circular supports an SFC-authorised-fund assessment context, but does not establish that paragraph 3.11 applies only to such funds.

Gift status and discount status remain supplied judgments. Guaranteed returns are not automatically gifts, and underlying-fund-return provenance does not itself establish an exemption. A discount in one component does not exempt a separate gift.

node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b distinguishes the offeror from the funder or fulfiller. Testing the offeror is consistent with the quoted rule, but detailed attribution standards for third-party arrangements are not supplied.

Passing the selected gift control establishes neither disclosure compliance nor compliance with separate advertising or structured-product requirements. Neither assessed claim adds a gift restriction or permission.

The supplied source establishes no operative date interval. Temporal availability and dependency-wide conflict blocking are implementation conventions, not legal requirements established by this circular.
